note: FREE-YAW camera (2026-08-01). Frame index = RELATIVE azimuth: unit facing yaw MINUS the LIVE camera yaw, plus the bake's own cameraYaw. The key light is baked CAMERA-RELATIVE, which is what makes one cell legal for every (facing, camera) pair that shares a difference.

bake.azimuthOrder: index a = round(wrap(facingYaw - cameraYawLive + cameraYaw) / (2PI/A)) mod A; a=0 faces the camera

tintFormula: rgb = base.rgb * mix(vec3(1.0), tint, mask) + tintEmissive * mask;  alpha = base.a
